subject: math
objective: Multiply and divide whole numbers and decimals by 10, 100, 1,000, and 10,000 (including exponent form) by placing the decimal point and any placeholder zeros correctly, and explain the move in terms of place value.
misconceptions: Moving the point the wrong way
Moving the wrong number of places
Leaving out placeholder zeros or the 0 in the ones place
Thinking the point moves rather than the digits
Grouping commas from the left or putting commas in the decimal part
modelLimitations: Numbers are limited to 7 whole-number digits and 4 decimal places.
Only powers of ten up to 10,000 are used.
Moving the point is a shortcut; the place-value chart shows the digits shifting while the point stays fixed.
Scores are kept only for the current page session; nothing is stored.
